(LEANSPHINCS_SCHEME, msghash, pubkey_hash): LeanSPHINCS identifies the signature scheme to use, msghash is the hash of the transaction/message being authorized, and pubkey_hash identifies the public key expected to verify that signature.

The dependency is then checked in the VERIFY frame.
